nom: Cetaphil Baby Advanced Protection Cream With Organic Calendula

avis.titre: Love the smell- Love the texture- Love how my baby's skins feels afterwards
avis.texte: Love the smell, love the texture, love how my baby's skins feels afterwards. It soaks in so quickly and baby skin looks plump and dewy and fresh. Baby smells fresh, too. The lotion is yellow in color due to some of the natural ingredients used (calendula, I think). I was using the regular Cetaphil and the Mustela Hydra Bebe lotion on my child before. I tried this on a whim. She loves it and the fact it's yellow probably because all her other lotion was white and this new color is interesting to her. This lotion feels and works more like the Mustela than the original Cetaphil, which I like better anyway. I deducted one star because I do not like the packaging. I would much rather prefer a bottle with pump than the squeeze bottle it comes in. Granted the lotion is on the liquid side pour easily and quickly, but the pump is just more convenient when you have a squirmy toddler or baby to deal with. I really enjoy this lotion and would recommend. I don't recommend if you are looking for a fragrance free lotion though.

I initially bought this for my baby's sensitive skin, but as he grew up, I had some left over. With my most recent pregnancy, I started to have very itchy and annoyingly dry skin. My standard "mama to be lotion" (From competitor who will remain nameless) wasn't cutting it. I asked my OB about what I should do. She recommended "cutting out all the froo froo lotions, and getting something FOR dry skin." ... she recommended Cetaphil by name. I used my leftover stuff I had, about 1/2 a bottle and I am pleased to report, not only is this stuff amazing for moisturizing the skin, but I also did not get a single stretch mark! :O I combined this lotion, after showers, with Burts Bees Lemon Body Oil.. so i'm not really sure which one is responsible for that. BUT. I am very grateful. I'm almost 37 weeks, and my tummy is HUGE.. the biggest its ever been with any of my kiddos, and I gained the most weight, and i'm still SHOCKED that I don't have a single stretch mark. (I'm also already dropped since week 34-35) I have MANY "white-faded" ones from previous babies, and fully thought, "Stretch marks run in the family, and in your genes, and you cannot prevent them." .. I don't believe that anymore, as I have the complete opposite, with using this product. My tummy is baby smooth, not itchy, and beautiful thanks for this lotion! I couldn't be more pleased. Oh. The scent is pleasant. The lotion is airy and rubs into the skin beautifully, no oily after feel. It rubs in and feels more like water

I have been using the Cetaphil Daily Baby Lotion with organic marigold and vitamin E and loved it. It has a light texture, absorbs quickly and leaves skin very soft and hydrated without feeling greasy. Its aroma is soft and pleasant, ideal for sensitive skin. It also helps keep skin moisturized throughout the day. It is certainly a product of excellent quality that I would buy again and I recommend to those looking for a soft and effective lotion for the whole family.

avis.titre: Great choice for adults' sensitive skin
avis.texte: Was extremely disappointed when Aveeno discontinued creamy baby oil. This is what I've used since. I have sensitive skin and this is perfect. Pretty light, absorbs quickly, two oils for moisture. Don't be turned off by the yellow color of the lotion, doesn't show when applied. Bought this in a three-pack, was much cheaper than drugstores. Many are no longer carrying it; hope that's not the case here. Have recommended to friends, who like it as well.
I give to my friend’s baby, she loves it and no allergies at all

avis.titre: Finally found a lotion that works for my baby's skin
avis.texte: I have been using the Cetaphil Baby Daily Lotion with Organic Calendula for a few weeks now and I am really happy with it. My baby has quite sensitive skin that tends to get dry patches, so I am always careful about what products I use. The first thing I noticed is how lightweight it feels. It is not thick or greasy at all and it absorbs into the skin almost immediately, which is great when you are trying to dress a wriggly baby after a bath. It leaves his skin feeling incredibly soft and hydrated until the next day. The scent is very mild and pleasant, not overpowering like some other baby brands. I love that it contains organic calendula because it seems to really soothe any redness or irritation. We have had no breakouts or bad reactions since switching to this. It is a bit more expensive than the basic supermarket lotions, but a little goes a long way and the quality is definitely worth it for peace of mind. If your little one has sensitive skin, I would definitely suggest giving this a try.

avis.titre: Gentle and Perfect for Baby’s Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Cetaphil Baby Lotion for my baby, and I’m very happy with it. It’s gentle on sensitive skin, absorbs quickly, and keeps the skin soft and moisturized throughout the day without feeling greasy. It has a mild, pleasant fragrance and hasn’t caused any irritation. A great choice for daily baby skincare. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: NOT for children under 3 months of age
avis.texte: NOT RECOMMENDED for children under 3 months of age, per company. I was recommend by my daughters pediatrician cetaphil baby lotion . I put the product on her face and her legs started turning red and she started screaming, than my sister told me she put that lotion on her face and it burnt the crap out of her skin so I rushed over to the skin and started washing off her body and she cried for a good 5 minutes. After she settled down I called the company to complain ( I thought something was wrong with the lot) and they told me they don't recommend it for anyone under 3 months... but it does not say that on the bottle... it says pediatrician recommend. I am just upset that they don't put things like that on the bottle. If it's not recommend for a certain age group it needs to say that.

avis.titre: Did not get what we ordered
avis.texte: This is a great lotion that we have been using on our son since he was 4 months old. We were originally using Aveeno but it wasn’t helping much my son’s dry skin. Our pediatrician recommended a handful of lotions, cetaphil being one of them. The lotion smells good and it does it’s job moisturizing and keeping my son’s skin smooth and soft. He is now 2 and we still use it. I decided to get a subscription for this and specifically wanted the flip top style (just easier for the way I do things). Got the pump when the package arrived. Checked my order to double check that I didn’t mess up on my end. I didn’t. Not the end of the world but hopefully I get the style I wanted next time.
